svg.aria-label: Betaflight signal flow diagram for the current master branch
svg.title: Betaflight signal flow — master @ 617e84f11f (2026-09-16, 2026.12.0-alpha)
svg.desc: RX to motor command path, gyro and D-term filter chains, PID controller, mixer and motor output, the attitude outer loop and the airframe, with the RPM telemetry, throttle scheduling and physical feedback paths. Derived from the betaflight_processing diagram by mrRobot62, GPL-3.0.
